code_table_entry_get_list.title: List code table entries
code_table_entry_get_list.description: List the entries of a Blackbaud CRM / Altru code table (CodeTableEntryGetList) by its database table name, e.g. ADDRESSTYPECODE or TITLECODE - the allowed values for coded fields in data forms.
code_table_entry_get_list.notes: SOAP 1.2 call to AppFxWebService.asmx. The response is the raw SOAP XML reply; read the fields you need from it. Values are placed into the XML as given, so escape & as & and < as <.

vroot.description: The virtual directory that hosts AppFxWebService.asmx on your server - the path segment between the host and /AppFxWebService.asmx, e.g. bbappfx, or the site id on Blackbaud hosting (the part before /webui/ in the URL you log in to).

database.description: Database key sent as ClientAppInfo REDatabaseToUse - the databasename value in your Blackbaud CRM or Altru URL, e.g. BBInfinity.

client_app_name.description: Name identifying this client in Blackbaud's audit trail (ClientAppInfo ClientAppName).

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds before the server times the request out (ClientAppInfo TimeOutSeconds).

code_table_name.description: The code table's database table name, e.g. ADDRESSTYPECODE.

output.description: The CodeTableEntryGetListReply SOAP XML; Rows hold each entry's id, code and description.

data_form_load.title: Load a data form
data_form_load.description: Load a record's fields through a Blackbaud CRM / Altru view or edit data form (DataFormLoad), by form id and record id. Use it to read a record's details, or to fetch the current values and metadata before data_form_save.
data_form_load.notes: SOAP 1.2 call to AppFxWebService.asmx. The response is the raw SOAP XML reply; read the fields you need from it. Values are placed into the XML as given, so escape & as & and < as <.

vroot.description: The virtual directory that hosts AppFxWebService.asmx on your server - the path segment between the host and /AppFxWebService.asmx, e.g. bbappfx, or the site id on Blackbaud hosting (the part before /webui/ in the URL you log in to).

database.description: Database key sent as ClientAppInfo REDatabaseToUse - the databasename value in your Blackbaud CRM or Altru URL, e.g. BBInfinity.

client_app_name.description: Name identifying this client in Blackbaud's audit trail (ClientAppInfo ClientAppName).

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds before the server times the request out (ClientAppInfo TimeOutSeconds).

form_id.description: The data form instance id (GUID) of the view or edit form.

record_id.description: Id of the record to load. Empty for add forms without a load implementation.

context_record_id.description: Context record id, for forms that load values in the context of a parent record.

include_metadata.description: true to include the form's field definitions (captions, types, limits).

output.description: The DataFormLoadReply SOAP XML: DataFormItem values, TSLong and optional MetaData.

data_form_save.title: Save a data form
data_form_save.description: Create or update a record through a Blackbaud CRM / Altru add or edit data form (DataFormSave). For an add form, give context_record_id for the parent (e.g. the constituent for a new address) and leave record_id empty; for an edit form, give record_id. Returns the saved record's id. Load the form first with data_form_load to learn its field ids.
data_form_save.notes: SOAP 1.2 call to AppFxWebService.asmx. The response is the raw SOAP XML reply; read the fields you need from it. Values are placed into the XML as given, so escape & as & and < as <.

vroot.description: The virtual directory that hosts AppFxWebService.asmx on your server - the path segment between the host and /AppFxWebService.asmx, e.g. bbappfx, or the site id on Blackbaud hosting (the part before /webui/ in the URL you log in to).

database.description: Database key sent as ClientAppInfo REDatabaseToUse - the databasename value in your Blackbaud CRM or Altru URL, e.g. BBInfinity.

client_app_name.description: Name identifying this client in Blackbaud's audit trail (ClientAppInfo ClientAppName).

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds before the server times the request out (ClientAppInfo TimeOutSeconds).

form_id.description: The data form instance id (GUID) of the add or edit form.

values_xml.description: The field values to save. Field values as a sequence of <fv> elements, each <fv ID="FIELDID"><Value xsi:type="xsd:string">value</Value></fv> (use xsd:int, xsd:decimal, xsd:boolean or xsd:dateTime for typed values). The xsi and xsd prefixes are declared on the envelope.

record_id.description: Id of the record to update with an edit form. Empty for add forms.

context_record_id.description: Parent record id for add forms with context.

output.description: The DataFormSaveReply SOAP XML with the saved record's ID.

data_list_load.title: Load a data list
data_list_load.description: Run a Blackbaud CRM / Altru data list (DataListLoad) by its feature id and return its rows, optionally scoped to a context record and filtered by the list's parameters. Data lists are the tabular lists behind record tabs, e.g. a constituent's addresses or an event's registrants. Use simple_data_list_load for drop-down style simple lists and search_list_load to find records.
data_list_load.notes: SOAP 1.2 call to AppFxWebService.asmx. The response is the raw SOAP XML reply; read the fields you need from it. Values are placed into the XML as given, so escape & as & and < as <.

vroot.description: The virtual directory that hosts AppFxWebService.asmx on your server - the path segment between the host and /AppFxWebService.asmx, e.g. bbappfx, or the site id on Blackbaud hosting (the part before /webui/ in the URL you log in to).

database.description: Database key sent as ClientAppInfo REDatabaseToUse - the databasename value in your Blackbaud CRM or Altru URL, e.g. BBInfinity.

client_app_name.description: Name identifying this client in Blackbaud's audit trail (ClientAppInfo ClientAppName).

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds before the server times the request out (ClientAppInfo TimeOutSeconds).

data_list_id.description: The data list's feature id (System record ID GUID), from the feature metadata page or the list's spec.

context_record_id.description: Id of the record the list is scoped to, e.g. the constituent id for a constituent's address list. Empty for lists with no context.

parameters_xml.description: The list's filter parameters. Field values as a sequence of <fv> elements, each <fv ID="FIELDID"><Value xsi:type="xsd:string">value</Value></fv> (use xsd:int, xsd:decimal, xsd:boolean or xsd:dateTime for typed values). The xsi and xsd prefixes are declared on the envelope. Empty for none.

include_metadata.description: true to include the output column definitions (captions and field ids) in the reply.

output.description: The DataListLoadReply SOAP XML: MetaData output fields and Rows of values.

simple_data_list_load.title: Load a simple data list
simple_data_list_load.description: Run a Blackbaud CRM / Altru simple data list (SimpleDataListLoad) - the value/label lists behind drop-downs, such as record types or sites - and return its rows. Use data_list_load for full tabular lists.

vroot.description: The virtual directory that hosts AppFxWebService.asmx on your server - the path segment between the host and /AppFxWebService.asmx, e.g. bbappfx, or the site id on Blackbaud hosting (the part before /webui/ in the URL you log in to).

database.description: Database key sent as ClientAppInfo REDatabaseToUse - the databasename value in your Blackbaud CRM or Altru URL, e.g. BBInfinity.

client_app_name.description: Name identifying this client in Blackbaud's audit trail (ClientAppInfo ClientAppName).

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds before the server times the request out (ClientAppInfo TimeOutSeconds).

data_list_id.description: The simple data list's feature id (GUID).

parameters_xml.description: The list's parameters. Field values as a sequence of <fv> elements, each <fv ID="FIELDID"><Value xsi:type="xsd:string">value</Value></fv> (use xsd:int, xsd:decimal, xsd:boolean or xsd:dateTime for typed values). The xsi and xsd prefixes are declared on the envelope. Empty for none.

output.description: The SimpleDataListLoadReply SOAP XML with value/label rows.

record_operation_perform.title: Perform a record operation
record_operation_perform.description: Run a Blackbaud CRM / Altru record operation (RecordOperationPerform) on one record - most record operations delete a record or change its status, e.g. "Event Expense: Delete". Irreversible for deletes; confirm the record id first with data_form_load.
record_operation_perform.notes: SOAP 1.2 call to AppFxWebService.asmx. The response is the raw SOAP XML reply; read the fields you need from it. Values are placed into the XML as given, so escape & as & and < as <.

vroot.description: The virtual directory that hosts AppFxWebService.asmx on your server - the path segment between the host and /AppFxWebService.asmx, e.g. bbappfx, or the site id on Blackbaud hosting (the part before /webui/ in the URL you log in to).

database.description: Database key sent as ClientAppInfo REDatabaseToUse - the databasename value in your Blackbaud CRM or Altru URL, e.g. BBInfinity.

client_app_name.description: Name identifying this client in Blackbaud's audit trail (ClientAppInfo ClientAppName).

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds before the server times the request out (ClientAppInfo TimeOutSeconds).

record_id.description: Id of the record the operation acts on.

search_list_load.title: Run a search list
search_list_load.description: Search for records with a Blackbaud CRM / Altru search list (SearchListLoad), e.g. the constituent search fdf9d631-5277-4300-80b3-fdf5fb8850ec with KEYNAME and FIRSTNAME filters. Returns matching rows with record ids to pass to data_form_load, data_list_load or record_operation_perform.
search_list_load.notes: SOAP 1.2 call to AppFxWebService.asmx. The response is the raw SOAP XML reply; read the fields you need from it. Values are placed into the XML as given, so escape & as & and < as <.

vroot.description: The virtual directory that hosts AppFxWebService.asmx on your server - the path segment between the host and /AppFxWebService.asmx, e.g. bbappfx, or the site id on Blackbaud hosting (the part before /webui/ in the URL you log in to).

database.description: Database key sent as ClientAppInfo REDatabaseToUse - the databasename value in your Blackbaud CRM or Altru URL, e.g. BBInfinity.

client_app_name.description: Name identifying this client in Blackbaud's audit trail (ClientAppInfo ClientAppName).

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds before the server times the request out (ClientAppInfo TimeOutSeconds).

filter_xml.description: Search criteria. Field values as a sequence of <fv> elements, each <fv ID="FIELDID"><Value xsi:type="xsd:string">value</Value></fv> (use xsd:int, xsd:decimal, xsd:boolean or xsd:dateTime for typed values). The xsi and xsd prefixes are declared on the envelope. E.g. <fv ID="KEYNAME"><Value xsi:type="xsd:string">Smith</Value></fv>.

output.description: The SearchListLoadReply SOAP XML; Output.Rows holds the matches.
